name: Conditional Antimatroids
summary: One-inclusion graphs of finite intersection-closed families containing the empty set in which every member is generated by its extremal elements, considered up to cube symmetries and suppression of constants.
aliases: intersection-closed ample classes up to coordinate flips
comments: A conditional antimatroid need not contain its whole ground set. If it does, it is a convex geometry. This class is larger than the ideals of convex geometries; the latter are a special kind of bouquet. The minor atlas denotes this same signed-coordinate class by Bouq±; the coordinate flip is existential and is not ambient complementation.
